structure: Grade-level course file. Page 1: title line (u1), course overview narrative, LEA disclaimer, strand legend (I, B, C&G, E, G, H). Then an Inquiry band table (Category | Indicator; codes I.1.n; band K-2, 3-5 or 6-8 as headed) shared by all grades in the band. Then a Standards | Objectives table: column 1 = strand standard (e.g. 4.B.1 = grade.strand.standard), column 2 = bulleted objectives (4.B.1.1 ...). Strands B, C&G, E, G, H. Table header row repeats on each page. Page-break table fragments (stray bullets and split sentence tails) appear as extra small tables.

labels.section: Course overview narrative (United States History); also contains the LEA disclaimer start
LEA disclaimer tail, inquiry-strand note, strand legend
